title: Stack and Switch Tres Idiomas
style: modern dancehall pop, syncopated kick pattern, bright synth stabs, tropical horn line, female lead with male toaster ad-libs, three-language verse rotation, pickleball coaching anthem, uplifting club energy, 102 bpm, viral hook
lyrics:
[Intro]
Stack and switch, stack and switch
Keep your strong side, find your pitch

[Verse 1 — English]
Lefty and a righty, forehands in the middle
Stack on the same side, solve the little riddle
Server up front, partner right behind
After the serve they switch, leave the weak side blind
Forehands together, backhands away
Stack and switch, that is how you play

[Chorus — Tres Idiomas]
Stack and switch, apila y cambia, dié jiā huàn
Forehands middle, derechas al centro, zhèng shǒu zhōng jiān
Keep the strong side, lado fuerte, qiáng biān liú
Stack and switch, apila y cambia, dié jiā huàn

[Verse 2 — Español]
Zurdo y derecho, derechas al medio
Apila al mismo lado, ese es el remedio
Sacador al frente, compañero atrás
Después del saque cambian, no mires atrás
Fuerza unida, ataque ganador
Apila y cambia, ese es el sabor

[Chorus — Tres Idiomas]
Stack and switch, apila y cambia, dié jiā huàn
Forehands middle, derechas al centro, zhèng shǒu zhōng jiān
Keep the strong side, lado fuerte, qiáng biān liú
Stack and switch, apila y cambia, dié jiā huàn

[Verse 3 — 中文]
Zuǒ shǒu yòu shǒu, zhèng shǒu zhōng jiān
Tóng yí biān dié, cè lüè qīngíng xian
Fā qiú zai qián, duì yǒu zai hòu
Fā wán huàn wèi, ruò diǎn bù liú
Liǎng gè qiáng shǒu, yī qǐ xiàn lí
Dié jiā huàn, wǒ men yíng lì

[Bridge]
Do not let them target the weak side
No dejes que ataquen el lado débil
Bú yào ràng tā men gong ji ruò biān
Stack it up, switch it up
Apila, cambia
Dié qǐ lai, huàn guò qù

[Outro]
Stack and switch, apila y cambia, dié jiā huàn
Viral viral, viral viral
Stack and switch forever
